items.title: Dispute over posthumous release of Siddhu Moose Wala's Phantom Ferrari song: Delhi HC refers case to mediation
items.summary: A dispute over whether music label Saga Music holds the rights to release the video of the "Phantom Ferrari" song sung by late singer Siddhu Moose Wala posthumously has been referred to mediation by the Delhi High Court. Siddhu Moose Wala’s parents have opposed the song's release, arguing that their permission has not been taken for releasing the song. On the other hand, Saga Music has asserted that the song's copyright was assigned to it by Moose Wala before his demise. Justice Manoj Jain today urged the parties to try and settle the dispute amicable manner. "Your son enjoys popularity sitting in heaven… It is better advised for both parties to find an amicable solution," the judge said, addressing the parents' counsel. The counsel said that he had no objection if the matter is referred to mediation. He also assured the Court that the parents will not issue any further statements to aggravate the dispute for the timebeing.
